summary.business_type: Free AI SaaS tool (YouTube SEO toolkit)
top_findings: Site lives entirely on free vercel.app subdomain — yt-seo-architect.com does not resolve (HTTP 000); no domain authority, backlink tracking, or brand-entity growth possible until a custom domain is live
Templated, grammatically broken blog meta descriptions ('Learn how to creating high click-through rates…') across ~59 posts + 5 pages with meta descriptions outside 120-160 chars (175-256 chars)

Blog posts make statistical claims with zero citations — external links are Amazon affiliate tags, social share buttons, and GitHub; only 1 of 4 sampled posts cites primary sources (support.google.com, backlinko)
/tools/keyword-difficulty-scorer is a 59-word shell with no H2 — thin content targeting a head term

No Core Web Vitals field or lab data obtainable this audit (PSI rate-limited without API key; GSC/CrUX not connected; local Lighthouse interrupted) — proxy signals (77KB HTML, HTTP/2, Brotli, 0.29s TTFT) are healthy

Internal linking gaps: blog posts link to ZERO tool/guide pages; /tools index links only 23 of 52 tool pages; 8 /blog/category/* pages orphaned; /dashboard, /contact, /privacy-policy, /terms-of-service missing from sitemaps
Stale freshness badge: homepage footer says 'Updated May 2026' while llms.txt and newest post are 2026-08-17 — contradictory freshness signals for AI crawlers
Common Crawl has no host-level backlink data for vercel.app subdomain — backlink profile unverifiable without commercial index or GSC
quick_wins: Fix the 5 meta description length violations + broken 'Learn how to creating…' template (regenerate descriptions, target 120-160 chars)
Update homepage footer freshness badge from 'May 2026' to current date or remove it
Unify tool count: '85 free tools' (llms.txt) vs '90+ free tools' (homepage/llms.txt header)
Link /contact from the footer (currently hidden — hurts trust signals)
Add lastmod to the 393 glossary sitemap URLs (currently 0/393 have lastmod)
Add H2 sections to /blog index (currently 0 H2s) for LLM/crawler summarization
Add affiliate disclosure near Amazon links on blog posts (compliance risk)

categories.name: Technical SEO
what_works: robots.txt exemplary: search + 8 AI answer-engine crawlers allowed, 14 training crawlers blocked, sitemap advertised
All 550 sitemap URLs return HTTP 200 — zero broken pages
Sitemap index + 3 children well-formed, zero duplicates, full coverage
Self-referencing canonicals on all sampled pages; index,follow everywhere; no noindex leaks
Security headers exemplary: CSP, HSTS preload, nosniff, X-Frame-Options, Referrer-Policy
Brotli + HTTP/2 + CDN cache hits

findings.title: lastmod missing on 89.5% of sitemap URLs
findings.description: Only 58/550 URLs have lastmod (all in sitemap-core.xml). The two glossary sitemaps (393 URLs) have zero lastmod entries.
findings.recommendation: Add lastmod (or changefreq/priority) to glossary sitemap URLs to strengthen freshness signals.

findings.title: No Core Web Vitals field data available
findings.description: PSI/CrUX API rate-limited without API key; GSC not connected; local Lighthouse was interrupted. LCP/CLS/INP unverified. Proxy signals healthy: 77KB HTML homepage, HTTP/2, Brotli, 0.29s TTFT.
findings.recommendation: Connect GSC once custom domain is live, add PageSpeed API key, and run full CrUX + Lighthouse to confirm LCP<2.5s / CLS<0.1 / INP<200ms.

findings.title: Redirect and 404 behavior unverified
findings.description: Redirect (http->https, trailing slash) and 404 handling checks were interrupted by a command guard. Vercel defaults are 308 http->https; custom 404 page existence unconfirmed.
findings.recommendation: Manually verify with curl once convenient; ensure a branded 404 with internal links.

categories.name: Content Quality
what_works: Blog posts are substantial (2,200-2,600 words each) with strong H2/H3 hierarchy (10-13 H2s incl. TL;DR, FAQ, Key Takeaways)
Pillar guide (2,147 words) and homepage (1,872 words) are healthy
Visible author byline 'Patrick' + dates on all posts; one post cites primary sources (support.google.com, backlinko)
Contact page exists with form; privacy policy + terms live in footer

findings.title: Blog posts make claims with zero citations
findings.description: 3 of 4 sampled posts contain numeric/statistical claims (thumbnail dimensions, revenue figures, FAQ answers) with no sources. External links are Amazon affiliate tags (tag=44HlecM), social share buttons, GitHub, youtube.com. Only /blog/youtube-seo-tips-for-creators-in-2026 cites support.google.com answers + backlinko.
findings.recommendation: Add primary-source citations (support.google.com/youtube, YouTube Creator blog, credible studies) to every post making claims; standardize the citation practice from the seo-tips post across the pipeline.

findings.title: Thin tool page: /tools/keyword-difficulty-scorer
findings.description: 59 words of visible text, zero H2s, no FAQ, no how-to copy, no internal links to guides. Targets the 'keyword difficulty' head term with an empty shell (content is client-side generated).
findings.recommendation: Build out the page with 300-600 words of how-to copy, FAQ, and links to relevant guides/tools.

findings.title: Readability at 11th-12th grade level
findings.description: Flesch Reading Ease 41.9-49.1 (Flesch-Kincaid grade 11.3-12.0) on sampled posts, for a target audience of YouTube creators (typically high-school reading level).
findings.recommendation: Shorten sentences, simplify vocabulary; target FRE 60+.

findings.title: Affiliate links without disclosure
findings.description: All sampled posts contain Amazon affiliate links (tag=44HlecM) and Canva/Adobe affiliate params without visible disclosure.
findings.recommendation: Add 'contains affiliate links' disclosure near affiliate links (FTC compliance + trust).

findings.title: Thin founder identity on /about
findings.description: 'Patrick' has no surname, photo, LinkedIn, credentials story, or email on About page. Organization sameAs has only 3 entries. Single shared author across all posts reads as automated.
findings.recommendation: Expand founder identity: full name, photo, bio, credentials, LinkedIn; vary author attribution where genuine.

findings.title: /pricing is thin (266 words)
findings.description: Thin but acceptable for a $0 pricing page; lacks FAQ/feature detail for 'youtube seo tool pricing' queries.
findings.recommendation: Add feature comparison + FAQ to pricing page.

categories.name: On-Page SEO
what_works: Every page has exactly one H1; titles present and brand-suffixed on all pages
Blog posts have excellent H2/H3 hierarchy; homepage 10 H2 / 26 H3
Internal linking on homepage strong (47 links, 41 internal, descriptive anchors, zero generic anchors)
All 59 blog posts linked from /blog index; related-post links in bodies; breadcrumbs present

findings.title: Templated, grammatically broken blog meta descriptions
findings.description: 'Learn how to youtube content calendar template 2026. Step-by-step guide with examples, tools, and strategies for 2026. Free tools included.' — identical skeleton with keyword swapped; 'Learn how to creating high click-through rates…' is broken grammar. Pattern appears on all ~59 posts.
findings.recommendation: Regenerate unique, grammatical meta descriptions per post (120-160 chars) in the blog pipeline.

findings.title: Meta description length violations on 5 pages
findings.description: / = 175 chars, /guides = 169, /guides/youtube-seo-strategy-2026 = 193, /tools/channel-audit-score = 256 (severely over, wrong boilerplate describing a text analyzer), /tools/keyword-difficulty-scorer = 108 (short).
findings.recommendation: Rewrite to 120-160 chars; fix channel-audit-score boilerplate that describes the wrong tool.

findings.title: Ungrammatical templated titles on blog posts
findings.description: 'Creating High Click-through Rates Youtube Thumbnails 2026', 'Boost Youtube Channel Revenue Streams 2026' — missing articles, lowercase 'youtube', templated 'X 2026 — YT SEO Architect' pattern.
findings.recommendation: Rewrite titles with proper grammar; add articles ('How to Create High CTR YouTube Thumbnails in 2026').

findings.title: Title/H1 mismatch on /blog/youtube-seo-tips-for-creators-in-2026
findings.description: <title> = 'YouTube Tags 2026…' but H1 = 'YouTube SEO Tips for Creators in 2026…' — title describes a different article, ends with literal '…' ellipsis (template bug).
findings.recommendation: Fix the title to match the article topic.

findings.title: Blog posts link to zero tools/guides; /tools index links only 23 of 52 tool pages
findings.description: Money pages (85 tools) get no contextual link equity from articles; ~29 tool pages are unreachable from the tools hub (only via guides/sitemap).
findings.recommendation: Add contextual tool/guide links inside post bodies; complete the /tools index to list all tool pages.

findings.title: 8 orphaned /blog/category/* pages
findings.description: Category pages (monetization, shorts, analytics, optimization, strategy, growth, tools, niche) exist in sitemap but are linked from nowhere; no post links to its category.
findings.recommendation: Link categories from posts and blog index, or noindex them.

findings.title: /dashboard, /contact, /privacy-policy, /terms-of-service missing from sitemaps
findings.description: All live (200) but absent from sitemap-core.xml; /contact also missing from footer (only reachable via in-content links).
findings.recommendation: Add to sitemap; add /contact to footer.

findings.title: /blog index has zero H2 structure
findings.description: 1 H3, no H2s — no category grouping for crawlers/LLMs summarizing the listing of 72 posts.
findings.recommendation: Add H2 sections (Latest Guides, Popular Topics, By Channel Type).

categories.name: Schema / Structured Data
what_works: All JSON-LD parses valid (0 parse errors across all audited pages)
Homepage @graph: Organization (name, url, logo, email, 3 sameAs, founder Person w/ GitHub), WebSite, SoftwareApplication (price 0, 17 features, speakable), FAQPage (8 Q/A), BreadcrumbList
Blog posts: Article schema complete (headline, datePublished, dateModified, author, mainEntityOfPage) + FAQPage (5 Q/A) + speakable xpaths
Tool/guide/about/pricing pages all carry correct page types (WebApplication, CollectionPage, AboutPage, WebPage)

findings.title: Article used instead of BlogPosting on blog posts
findings.description: Posts use 'Article' — valid, but BlogPosting is the recommended, more specific type for blog posts.
findings.recommendation: Switch posts to BlogPosting.

findings.title: WebSite schema lacks SearchAction; /blog index has zero structured data
findings.description: No sitelinks searchbox potentialAction; blog hub has no ItemList/Blog schema while /tools has WebPage + ItemList.
findings.recommendation: Add SearchAction to WebSite; add ItemList/Blog schema to /blog.

findings.title: Homepage BreadcrumbList has only 1 item
findings.description: Technically valid but useless — a single-item breadcrumb.
findings.recommendation: Remove or populate with real breadcrumbs.

categories.name: Performance (CWV)
what_works: Proxy signals healthy: 77KB homepage HTML, HTTP/2, Brotli compression, 0.29s TTFT, CDN cache hits
Images dimensioned, lazy-loaded except LCP hero (eager + fetchpriority=high — correct)
No heavy third-party render-blocking scripts in raw HTML

findings.title: No lab or field CWV numbers obtainable this audit
findings.description: PSI/CrUX API rate-limited without API key (240 QPM shared pool); GSC/CrUX not connected; local Lighthouse interrupted by command guard. LCP/CLS/INP unverified.
findings.recommendation: Add a PageSpeed API key, connect GSC, run CrUX + Lighthouse. Asset profile suggests good CWV but it is unverified.

categories.name: AI Search Readiness
what_works: robots.txt exemplary AI policy: ChatGPT-User, Google-Extended, PerplexityBot, ClaudeBot, anthropic-ai, OAI-SearchBot, Applebot-Extended, Bytespider allowed; GPTBot, CCBot, GrokBot, Amazonbot, cohere-ai, AI2Bot etc. blocked
llms.txt: spec-perfect (H1, blockquote, H2 sections, 316 bullet links), fresh (Updated 2026-08-17), deep coverage (core pages + 72 posts + 126 guides + 111 glossary terms)
Citability strong: bylines, dates, article:published_time, primary-source citations on monetize post, speakable schema, Direct Answer-first structure
Full Organization/WebSite/SoftwareApplication entity graph with logo + sameAs

findings.title: Site entirely on free vercel.app subdomain — no custom domain
findings.description: yt-seo-architect.com does not resolve (HTTP 000, DNS NXDOMAIN). All content, llms.txt, JSON-LD, canonicals, social shares live on the vercel.app subdomain. Consequence: no domain authority; vercel.app subdomains filtered by SEO tools and some AI link extractors; brand queries can't surface a branded domain; backlink building unattributeable at domain level.
findings.recommendation: Register yt-seo-architect.com (and consider .ai/.io), point DNS at Vercel, add custom domain in project settings, 301-redirect vercel.app → custom domain, update llms.txt, sitemap, and all JSON-LD url/@id fields.

findings.title: Stale freshness badge contradicts llms.txt
findings.description: Homepage footer badge: '✅ Updated May 2026 — actively maintained' while llms.txt says 2026-08-17 and newest post is dated 2026-08-17. AI crawlers reading both see conflicting freshness.
findings.recommendation: Update the footer badge to the current date or remove it.

findings.title: Tool count inconsistency (85 vs 90+)
findings.description: llms.txt Tools bullet says '85 free interactive tools'; homepage meta and llms.txt header say '90+ tools'.
findings.recommendation: Pick one number and use it everywhere.

findings.title: No blockquotes; thin author entity; generic affiliate links
findings.description: Zero blockquotes (quotes boost citability); author 'Patrick' has no last name/LinkedIn in Person schema; Amazon affiliate links are generic/off-topic.
findings.recommendation: Add expert quotes, enrich author bio, keep affiliate links topically relevant.

categories.name: Images
what_works: 0/3 images missing alt, 0/3 missing width/height across homepage + blog post
Descriptive, keyword-relevant alt text; correct lazy/eager strategy (LCP hero eager + fetchpriority=high)
og:image 1200x630 verified 200 with og:image:width/height/type; twitter:card summary_large_image
Logo (10KB), hero (142KB), og-image (197KB) all live

Regenerate grammatical, unique meta descriptions for all ~59 blog posts + fix 5 over/under-length descriptions (/, /guides, strategy guide, channel-audit-score, keyword-difficulty-scorer) (HIGH)
Add source citations to blog posts making claims — standardize the citation pattern from the seo-tips post across the pipeline (HIGH)
Build out /tools/keyword-difficulty-scorer with 300-600 words, FAQ, guide links (HIGH)

Add contextual links from blog posts to tools/guides; complete /tools index (23→52 tool pages) (MEDIUM)
De-orphan 8 /blog/category/* pages (link from posts or noindex) (MEDIUM)
Add /dashboard, /contact, /privacy-policy, /terms-of-service to sitemap-core.xml (MEDIUM)
Add /contact to footer (MEDIUM)
Add affiliate disclosure near Amazon/Canva/Adobe links (MEDIUM)
Fix stale 'Updated May 2026' footer badge; unify 85-vs-90 tool count (MEDIUM/LOW)
Improve blog readability to FRE 60+ (MEDIUM)

phases.name: Phase 3: Content & Authority
items: Expand founder identity on /about (surname, photo, LinkedIn, credentials) (MEDIUM)
Switch Article → BlogPosting; add SearchAction to WebSite; add ItemList/Blog schema to /blog index (LOW)
Add H2 sections to /blog index; add blockquotes/expert quotes to posts (LOW)
Start backlink building once custom domain is live: dev.to, GitHub, niche directories, guest posts (HIGH impact, requires Phase 1)

items: Connect GSC + add PageSpeed API key; verify CWV field data (LCP<2.5s, CLS<0.1, INP<200ms) (MEDIUM)

Monitor indexation via GSC once connected; track head-term rankings
Re-run this audit after custom domain migration to confirm canonicals/llms.txt/schema updated
